description:
Fetches a public web page and scans its visible text plus hidden HTML (comments, hidden elements, alt/aria/meta text) for prompt injection before your agent browses or summarizes it. Respects robots.txt; refuses private hosts. Returns risk_score (0-100), verdict (safe | suspicious | malicious), findings[] with location (visible or hidden), finalUrl, title and hidden_html stats. Free: 30 calls/day per IP shared with scan_text and scan_tools.
Not for: text you already have (use scan_text) or MCP tool definitions (use scan_tools). A safety signal, not a guarantee.

[InjectScan via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as InjectScan's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: scan $0.003 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

tier.description: Paid tier: scan $0.003. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

items.description: A tool definition: name, description and inputSchema (MCP tools/list or OpenAI/Anthropic shape).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the tool input.

url.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL of a public web page, e.g. "https://example.com/post". Private, loopback and internal hosts are refused; robots.txt is respected.
